sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The obstacles in the game are generated randomly, and the difficulty level increases with each level. The game also features a multiplier system, where you can earn more points by collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles. The bird has three lives, and if you lose all your lives, the game is over. The game also features a leaderboard where you can compete with your friends and other players to get the highest score.

The gameplay mechanics are easy to learn, but difficult to master. With each failure, you'll learn from your mistakes and improve your skills, making the game even more enjoyable and addictive.
